verdict.rationale: Clerky does ship a Partner API and a remote MCP server, but nothing shows either one can draft an NDA or route one for signature. The Partner API currently supports only Delaware C-Corp formations, and its OAuth access is still listed as 'coming soon'. The MCP server is OAuth-gated, and the probe notes that, per the docs, its tools are read-only and team-scoped. NDAs are not mentioned anywhere in the evidence.
